title: AI Engineer/Data Scientist
description: I led the design and delivery of an end-to-end Driver Monitoring System across cloud and edge environments, enabling real-time driver behaviour detection with privacy-preserving features. My role focused on architecting scalable computer vision and data pipelines, optimizing ML systems for low-latency and resource-constrained deployments, and building production-grade AWS infrastructure with robust CI/CD. I also drove engineering standards and cross-functional collaboration to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions, while fostering innovation through leading an internal AI community.
